text:
Maya: SI just reported reproducible perf regressions on ROCm 5.6 + driver 22.40 on MI250 hosts in us-west-2 marketplace images. p99 up and occasional OOMs. tagging @Luca @Priya for partner comms.
Luca: Which marketplace image + workload? any stack traces or mini repro?
Maya: image: r-inference:2026-03-22-rocm5.6. workload: long-form gen seq=1024 batch=4. p99 ~350ms vs baseline ~220ms. quick local run:
```
# repro in canary-host
python run_perf.py --model llama-7b --seq 1024 --batch 4 --device mi250
# observed: p99=350ms, baseline p99=220ms
# dmesg excerpt: "[drm] HSA kernel panic: vm fault at ..."
```
Priya: That dmesg smells like ROCm/userland mismatch or new kernel driver change. SI pushed a firmware + HSA patch last week. Can we pin marketplace images to ROCm 5.5 while SI triages?
Sam: For Hosted API customers we can do a routing policy to redirect requests to the dedicated pool running rocm-5.5. For marketplace, a manifest-level pin and canary lane seems right. Also recommend adding a compat-mode env var to opt into older kernels.
SI-ops: We'll reproduce in our lab this afternoon and provide the exact kernel module diffs. Sharing draft changelog: https://si.example.com/rocm/changelog/5.6-diff
marketplace-bot: Runbook: marketplace-hotfix-create triggered (id: run-2026-03-22-451)
Maya: Proposed immediate plan:
  1) Create marketplace manifest override to pin ROCm=5.5 (`r-inference-rocm55-pin`) and push to canary lane in us-west-2 + eu-central-1
  2) Kick smoke + perf gate (seq=1024, batch=4) with assert p99 < 260ms
  3) Notify partners & SI with rollback steps and request signed perf vectors
  4) Postmortem + long-term: add automated preflight perf gate to marketplace CI and a per-driver compatibility matrix
ETA for canary push: ~3 hours. objections?
Luca: No objections. Please include manifest diff and quick rollback command in the runbook.
Priya: I'll draft the partner-facing note and ping the SI account manager. Also recommend we add an opt-in compat flag for marketplace customers who want the latest ROCm early.
Sam: I'll wire up the routing rule for hosted->dedicated fallback and add telemetry to catch any increased OOM rates.
marketplace-bot: Canary build queued (build id: cb-451-1). Canary telemetry will post to #marketplace-canaries when done.
Maya: Rollback snippet for manifest:
```
# pin ROCm version in manifest
sed -E 's/rocmVersion: .*/rocmVersion: "5.5"/' marketplace/manifest.yaml > marketplace/manifest.rocm55.yaml
# push to canary lane
ci push-manifest --lane canary --manifest marketplace/manifest.rocm55.yaml
```
SI-ops: We'll attach kernel module diffs and a list of affected images once reproduced. Expect update in ~90m.
Maya: Thanks. Holding partner comms until SI confirms repro and canary telemetry is green. :white_check_mark:
